For many years, there was no Driver
capable of wielding Iira's secret
treasure.

rows.label: tlk70000080_10_msg0004

Laura-sama and Shin-sama in this era.

I'll do everything I can to help
defeat Heaven's Holy Grail, so please
ask anything of me.
